description: This file implements a command handler for processing '/approve' commands in a chat application, including parsing commands, authorization checks, and calling external gateway methods to submit approvals.

methods.name: parseApproveCommand
methods.description: Parses the raw command string to extract approval ID and decision, handling command syntax and decision aliases.

methods.name: buildResolvedByLabel
methods.description: Constructs a label indicating the source of the approval command based on channel and sender ID.

methods.name: formatApprovalSubmitError
methods.description: Formats error objects into user-readable error messages.

methods.name: resolveApprovalMethods
methods.description: Determines which approval resolution methods to call based on approval ID and authorization status.

methods.name: resolveApprovalAuthorizationError
methods.description: Generates an error message if the user is not authorized to approve.
